title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00004:part:1/1

Article 3 (Chief Investigation Officer)
(1) A Chief Investigation Officer shall be assigned to the Seoul Family Court.
(2) The Chief Investigation Officer shall be appointed from among chief court administrative officers or chief investigation administrative officers.
(3) The Chief Investigation Officer shall, under the direction of a superior, direct and supervise family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, domestic protection case investigation officers, and child protection case investigation officers, and shall exercise overall control over their duties. [Amended on September 1, 2014.]
